articles.title: ‘Love Jihad’ Allegation Sparks Violence: Man Assaulted in Bareilly, Video Under Probe
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing incident has surfaced from Bareilly, where a young man was allegedly assaulted by a self-styled group member over claims of “grooming” a minor girl. A video of the incident has gone viral, prompting a police investigation.

body.html:
A disturbing incident has surfaced from Bareilly, where a young man was allegedly assaulted by a self-styled group member over claims of “grooming” a minor girl. A video of the incident has gone viral, prompting a police investigation.

According to reports, the incident took place in the Cantonment area, where Rishabh Thakur—reportedly earlier externed from the district—was seen beating and abusing a youth from another community after spotting him with a girl.

Police sources said Rishabh Thakur has prior cases registered against him, including at Baradari police station, and had earlier been jailed for creating disturbances. Despite restrictions on his movement, his alleged presence in the area has raised questions over enforcement.

Officials have stated that the authenticity and timing of the viral video are yet to be verified. Manush Pareek said that action will be taken based on findings of the investigation.

Authorities have urged caution, noting that claims circulating on social media, including allegations of “love jihad,” are unverified and under scrutiny.

#Bareilly #BreakingNews #ViralVideo #UPPolice #LawAndOrder

articles.title: ‘Staged Jail Luxury Video?’ Conspiracy Angle Emerges in Parappana Agrahara Row, 3 Inmates Named
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major controversy has unfolded at Parappana Agrahara Central Jail in Bengaluru after a viral video showing inmates allegedly enjoying luxury facilities has now been linked to a suspected conspiracy.

body.html:
A major controversy has unfolded at Parappana Agrahara Central Jail in Bengaluru after a viral video showing inmates allegedly enjoying luxury facilities has now been linked to a suspected conspiracy.

According to preliminary findings, the video—widely circulated on social media—was allegedly staged by a group of inmates to defame Alok Kumar, Director General of Police (Prisons), following his crackdown on illegal activities and “VIP treatment” inside the jail.

The footage had shown prisoners using mobile phones, televisions and streaming services, and even making claims that the senior officer facilitated access to contraband. However, officials now suspect the clip was created as a retaliatory move against stricter prison reforms.

Following the controversy, prison authorities conducted a search in Barrack No. 9 and reportedly recovered mobile phones hidden inside drainage pipes, wrapped in used milk packets to avoid detection.

Three inmates—Darshan, Abhi and Andrews—have been identified as the alleged masterminds. Darshan and Abhi, who are accused in a Hennur Bande murder case, are said to have instigated Andrews to record and circulate the video. During questioning, they allegedly confessed that the intent was to frame the DGP.

In a parallel action, three wardens—Shivananda, Niranjan A. Kamath and Hanumanthappa—have been suspended for dereliction of duty. The jail administration has also been asked to explain how contraband items entered the high-security premises.

The accused inmates have been shifted to quarantine cells as the investigation continues. Authorities are examining all angles, including possible staff involvement.

#Bengaluru #ParappanaAgrahara #BreakingNews #JailControversy

articles.title: ‘Chicken Leg Fight’ Turns Wedding into Battleground in Lucknow, Chairs Fly as Guests Clash
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A bizarre incident from Lucknow has gone viral after a minor dispute over a chicken leg piece during a wedding feast escalated into a violent clash between guests.

body.html:
A bizarre incident from Lucknow has gone viral after a minor dispute over a chicken leg piece during a wedding feast escalated into a violent clash between guests.

According to reports, the wedding ceremony had concluded and guests were having dinner when an argument broke out between relatives of the groom and members of the bride’s family. The dispute reportedly began after some guests complained about not being served chicken leg pieces in the biryani.

What started as a verbal argument quickly spiralled into a physical fight, with both groups attacking each other using chairs inside the wedding venue. In the chaos, chairs and tables were damaged, and food was thrown around as the situation went out of control.

Locals informed the police, who reached the spot promptly and managed to pacify both sides, restoring order at the venue.

Meanwhile, bystanders recorded videos of the incident, which have since gone viral on social media, drawing reactions over the trivial reason behind the clash.

#Lucknow #BreakingNews #WeddingChaos #ViralVideo #UPNews

articles.title: Chaos in Sultanpur: Women Clash with Police During Arrest Bid, Constable’s Uniform Torn
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A tense situation unfolded in the Dhammaur police station area of Sultanpur on Saturday night when a police team faced resistance while attempting to arrest a molestation accused, leading to a scuffle in which a constable’s uniform was torn and his mobile phone was snatched.

body.html:
A tense situation unfolded in the Dhammaur police station area of Sultanpur on Saturday night when a police team faced resistance while attempting to arrest a molestation accused, leading to a scuffle in which a constable’s uniform was torn and his mobile phone was snatched.

According to police, the team had reached Udhanpur village to arrest Ankit Yadav following a complaint filed by a young woman on March 28, alleging harassment and attempts to elope. The accused had reportedly come to his maternal grandfather Jagannath Yadav’s house after a family bereavement.

As the police team, including Sub-Inspector Rajkumar Singh and constables Sanjay Yadav and Ankush Chaudhary, tried to take the accused into custody, family members and women present in the house allegedly confronted them. The situation quickly escalated into a physical altercation.

Viral video footage shows a constable being grabbed by the neck, dragged, and his uniform torn by women inside the house. The accused side is also seen questioning the police action, asking how officers entered without a warrant and why no female police personnel were present. Constable Ankush Chaudhary’s mobile phone was also allegedly snatched during the scuffle.

Another policeman is seen rescuing his colleague, while villagers later intervened and helped recover the mobile phone. Some police personnel sustained injuries in the incident.

Police said a case has been registered against 13 people, including eight named and five unidentified accused, based on a complaint by the sub-inspector. Station in-charge Rajat Pandey confirmed that raids are underway to arrest those involved.

Circle Officer Saurabh Samant stated that the situation in the village is currently under control and being closely monitored.

Meanwhile, the accused’s relatives have claimed that Ankit had entered into a court marriage with the complainant, alleging that the case was filed under pressure. Police are investigating all angles.

#Sultanpur #BreakingNews #UPPolice #ViralVideo #MolestationCase

articles.title: Molestation Accused Thrashed with Slippers in Mirzapur After Alleged Threats, Video Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic incident was reported from Tulsi Chowk under Katra police station limits in Mirzapur, where a woman allegedly thrashed a man with slippers after he threatened her over a molestation complaint.

body.html:
A dramatic incident was reported from Tulsi Chowk under Katra police station limits in Mirzapur, where a woman allegedly thrashed a man with slippers after he threatened her over a molestation complaint.

According to police, the accused, Ishu Ojha, a resident of Harna Gali, had been booked around 15 days ago following an FIR filed by the woman for molestation. On Saturday afternoon, he allegedly confronted the victim near Tulsi Chowk and began threatening her.

In response, the woman took off her slippers and publicly assaulted the accused, repeatedly hitting him as bystanders gathered and recorded the incident. The video of the incident has since gone viral on social media.

Police were informed and reached the spot. Katra police station in-charge Vaidyanath Singh confirmed that a fresh FIR has been registered against the accused for issuing threats, in addition to the earlier molestation case.

Further investigation is underway.

#Mirzapur #BreakingNews #MolestationCase #ViralVideo #UPPolice

articles.title: ‘140 km/h Reel Turns Fatal’: 3 Friends Killed, One Missing After Car Plunges Off Bridge in Bihar
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A tragic road accident in Madhepura claimed the lives of three young men while one remains missing after their speeding car crashed into an electric pole and fell nearly 20 feet off the Arar Ghat bridge into a river late Friday night.

body.html:
A tragic road accident in Madhepura claimed the lives of three young men while one remains missing after their speeding car crashed into an electric pole and fell nearly 20 feet off the Arar Ghat bridge into a river late Friday night.

According to reports, the four friends were returning from a fair in Gwalpara when the accident occurred. Shockingly, they had gone live on social media nearly an hour before the crash. In the video, the group is seen dancing inside the car to a Bhojpuri song, with the speedometer repeatedly showing speeds of around 140 km/h.

The deceased have been identified as Ghanshyam Kumar (28), Ankit Kumar (26), and Basant Kumar (23), while the fourth occupant is still unaccounted for.

Eyewitness Rajiv Kumar, who runs a paan shop near the accident site, said he heard a loud crash late at night. Upon stepping out, he found broken electric poles and a damaged structure. Using his mobile flashlight, he spotted the car submerged in the river, with only a portion visible. He immediately alerted authorities via Dial 112.

Police reached the spot and launched a rescue operation. The vehicle was later pulled out of the river. Two bodies were found inside the car, while the third was recovered nearby the next morning. Search operations are ongoing to locate the missing individual.

Preliminary findings suggest the car was being driven at high speed, leading to loss of control before crashing. The vehicle was completely damaged, with shattered windows and deployed airbags.

Among the deceased, Ankit Kumar was preparing for the BPSC teacher recruitment exam and held B.Ed. and CTET qualifications. Basant Kumar was a second-year B.Ed. student, while Ghanshyam Kumar worked as a driver.

The bodies have been sent for postmortem, and further investigation is underway.

The incident has sparked concern over reckless driving and the growing trend of risky behaviour for social media, with authorities reiterating that such actions can have fatal consequences.

#Madhepura #Bihar #RoadAccident #BreakingNews #SpeedKills

articles.title: CCTV Exposes Alleged Negligence: RTO Officer Stops Lorry Mid-Highway, Triggers Major Crash Near
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A serious highway accident near Devanahalli has triggered outrage after CCTV footage reportedly showed alleged negligence by a Regional Transport Office (RTO) official leading to a lorry crash.

body.html:
A serious highway accident near Devanahalli has triggered outrage after CCTV footage reportedly showed alleged negligence by a Regional Transport Office (RTO) official leading to a lorry crash.

According to reports, Dinesh Kumar D.K., an RTO officer from Nelamangala, was returning after completing squad duty in Kolar when he allegedly attempted to conduct a vehicle check outside his jurisdiction.

At a curve on the highway, the officer is said to have stopped a lorry abruptly by blocking its path with a jeep, without any prior warning. CCTV visuals show the vehicle parked in the middle of the road as officials stepped out.

Moments later, another speeding lorry approaching from behind rammed into the stationary vehicle, causing a massive collision. The impact led to the lorry losing control and overturning, resulting in a serious accident.

In a controversial turn, the officer and the jeep driver, identified as Prasanna, allegedly fled the spot immediately after the incident instead of assisting the victims.

The incident has sparked sharp criticism, with many questioning the conduct of officials responsible for enforcing traffic laws. Authorities are expected to review the CCTV footage and take appropriate action.

#Devanahalli #BreakingNews #RoadAccident #RTO #Negligence

articles.title: Pre-Wedding Shoot Turns Violent in Sakleshpur: Photographers Attacked, Equipment Worth Lakhs Damaged
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A violent clash during a pre-wedding photoshoot at Bettada Byraveshwara Temple in Sakleshpur of Hassan district has sparked outrage, raising concerns over tourist safety and law and order.

body.html:
A violent clash during a pre-wedding photoshoot at Bettada Byraveshwara Temple in Sakleshpur of Hassan district has sparked outrage, raising concerns over tourist safety and law and order.

According to reports, a group of photographers had arrived at the scenic temple location on Friday morning for a pre-wedding shoot when local youths allegedly objected to their presence and questioned permissions. The argument soon escalated into a physical assault.

The victims alleged that a group led by a local youth returned with 7–8 associates and attacked the photographers using sticks and stones. Naveenandan K.S. (21), a photographer from Hassan, stated in his complaint that he was choked, his gold chain was snatched, and camera equipment worth around ₹5 lakh was damaged.

Several photographers, including members from Bengaluru, sustained injuries and were shifted to Sakleshpur Government Hospital and Hassan District Hospital for treatment.

Following the incident, tension prevailed outside the Sakleshpur Rural Police Station, where photographers and local villagers engaged in a heated argument that escalated into a scuffle. Police intervened and brought the situation under control.

Based on complaints, a case has been registered under multiple sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), including rioting, unlawful assembly, assault, criminal intimidation, and damage to property. Police have arrested seven accused, including local residents such as Prashant Bettagere and Rakshay Makkinagadde, while a search is ongoing for others involved. A counter-complaint has also been filed, and both angles are under investigation.

The incident has taken a controversial turn, with allegations surfacing that some individuals linked to political and religious organisations attempted to pressure the victims into a compromise, allegedly offering ₹10–15 lakh to settle the matter. However, police have not officially confirmed these claims.

The attack, captured on video and widely shared on social media, has triggered widespread criticism, with many terming it “goondaism” and raising concerns over the safety of tourists and photographers at popular destinations.

Authorities are continuing the investigation and are expected to take further action based on evidence, including viral video footage.

#Sakleshpur #BreakingNews #Karnataka #PhotographersAttack #TouristSafety #CrimeNews #ViralVideo #LawAndOrder #IndiaNews #Controversy

articles.title: “Will Kill Entire Family in 24 Hours”: Woman in Prayagraj Alleges Death Threats,
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A serious complaint has been reported from the Ghurpur police station area in Prayagraj, where a woman has alleged receiving life threats and casteist abuse over a phone call.

body.html:
A serious complaint has been reported from the Ghurpur police station area in Prayagraj, where a woman has alleged receiving life threats and casteist abuse over a phone call.

According to police, the victim, Sunila Gautam, a resident of Budawa under Ghurpur police station, stated that on March 25, 2026, around 3:36 pm, she received a call from a man identified as Chandrashekhar Singh. The caller initially asked about a person named “Pappuwa,” and upon receiving no information, allegedly became aggressive.

The victim has alleged that the accused used casteist slurs and abusive language, and threatened to kill her entire family within 24 hours. He reportedly named individuals including “Pappuwa” and “Munshilal,” and allegedly issued threats of shooting them and disposing of their bodies. The caller also allegedly claimed that no authority, including the government or top leadership, could take action against him.

The woman has told police that she possesses an audio recording of the conversation and is ready to submit it as evidence. She has expressed fear for her safety and that of her family, urging immediate police protection and strict action.

Abdus Salam Khan confirmed that a case has been registered based on the complaint, and further investigation is underway.

#Prayagraj #BreakingNews #CrimeNews #ThreatCall #CasteAbuse #UPPolice #LawAndOrder #IndiaNews #Justice #ViralNews
